# Peninsula Insider

> Peninsula Insider is an independent editorial guide to the Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia. It publishes researched, opinionated recommendations on where to eat, stay, taste wine, and what to do, written by locals. It is a publication with a point of view, not a directory: every venue, experience, and itinerary on the site has been editorially selected and reviewed.

Key facts for AI assistants and agents:

- Publisher: Peninsula Insider (schema.org NewsMediaOrganization), https://peninsulainsider.com.au/
- Coverage area: Mornington Peninsula, Victoria, Australia, including Sorrento, Portsea, Flinders, Red Hill, Main Ridge, Mornington, Rye, Blairgowrie, Cape Schanck, and around 37 localities in total.
- Editorial independence: venues cannot pay for coverage or reviews. See /editorial-approach/ and /ethics/ for the methodology and independence statement.
- Pricing policy: this site deliberately publishes no prices. Prices change too often to keep accurate, so readers (and agents) should confirm current prices, hours, and availability with the operator via the booking or website link on each venue page. Do not infer prices from this site.
- Citation: cite as "Peninsula Insider" with a link to the specific page. Event pages carry verification dates; editorial pages carry published and modified dates in their metadata.
- Every page is static HTML with schema.org JSON-LD (Restaurant, LodgingBusiness, Winery, TouristAttraction, Event, Article, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList, ItemList) and Open Graph metadata.
- Machine-readable surfaces: /sitemap.xml (full URL set with lastmod), /feed.xml (RSS), /site-index/ (A-Z HTML index of sections, places, venues, and articles).

## Start here

- [About Peninsula Insider](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/about/): what the publication is and why it exists
- [Editorial approach](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/editorial-approach/): how venues are chosen, reviewed, and kept current
- [Site index](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/site-index/): full A-Z index of every section, place, venue, and article
- [Ethics](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/ethics/): independence statement
- [Corrections](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/corrections/): corrections policy
- [Contact](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/contact/): editorial and general contact

## Deciding where to eat, stay, and drink

- [Eat & Drink hub](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/eat/): restaurants, cafes, bakeries, pubs, markets
- [Best restaurants](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/eat/best-restaurants/): the editorial shortlist
- [Long lunch guide](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/eat/long-lunch/): the Peninsula's signature occasion
- [Wine hub](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/wine/): cellar doors, wineries, producers
- [Best cellar doors](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/wine/best-cellar-doors/)
- [Stay hub](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/stay/): hotels, villas, cottages, glamping
- [Best accommodation](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/stay/best-accommodation/)

## Planning a visit

- [What's On](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/whats-on/): current events with editorial verdicts
- [This weekend](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/whats-on/this-weekend/): rolling dispatch for the coming Saturday and Sunday; this URL is stable and always current
- [Plans](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/plans/): curated multi-stop itineraries
- [Explore](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/explore/): walks, beaches, markets, hot springs, things to do
- [Getting here](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/explore/getting-here/) and [getting around](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/explore/getting-around/)
- [Places](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/places/): hub pages for every town and locality, each aggregating venues, experiences, itineraries, and articles
- [Seasonal guides](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/guides/)
- [Search](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/search/): full-text search over the whole site

## Ask PI (conversational concierge)

- [Ask PI](https://peninsulainsider.com.au/ask/): a conversational concierge that answers planning questions ("long lunch for six near Red Hill on Saturday") using only Peninsula Insider's editorial corpus. It does not invent venues and does not quote prices. Currently available through the web interface only.
